share.description: Create one read-only public page using the same bookmark workspace UI.
share.enabledHint: Anyone with the link can browse your live bookmarks. Editing and private controls stay unavailable.
share.slugInvalid: The link slug can only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, and must be at least 8 characters.
share.slugRotateWarning: Saving with an empty slug mints a fresh random link — the previous link stops working immediately.
share.linkDisabled: Enable sharing to create a public link.
